note: Patterns that must never appear in Saudi page copy. Enforced by scripts/check-content.js. The owner can extend this list; Arabic equivalents should be added by the native reviewer.

patterns.reason: Waleed Advertising is removed from scope entirely
no statements about contracts, invoicing, VAT or ZATCA
no office / 'based in' / 'our Saudi team' wording — in-person capability is only 'through our partner in Al Khobar'

patterns.regex: trusted by|clients across|businesses across the region|our clients|worked with
patterns.reason: no client-proof wording — we have no Saudi proof and must not imply any

patterns.regex: our office in|locally[- ]based|on the ground in|\boffices? in (saudi|khobar|dammam|dhahran|riyadh|jeddah)
patterns.reason: implies a presence/office we do not have
no wording implying Saudi registration or licensing

patterns.regex: مكتبنا في|مقرنا الرئيسي|مقيمون في|متواجدون في|على أرض الواقع في|فريق محلي|مقرنا في
patterns.reason: implies a presence/office we do not have (Arabic)

patterns.regex: مرخص|مرخّص|ترخيص|مسجل في السعودية|مسجلة في السعودية|سجل تجاري|السجل التجاري|رقم السجل
patterns.reason: no wording implying Saudi registration or licensing (Arabic)
